headline: Semble's new code search significantly reduces token usage compared to grep.

items.title: Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
items.summary: Semble, an open-source tool by Stephan and Thomas, addresses inefficiencies in code searches using agents like Claude Code. When traditional methods fail, agents typically fallback to using grep, consuming many tokens in the process. Semble optimizes this by dramatically reducing the token usage by 98%, enabling more efficient searches across large codebases without the need to read entire files. This innovation could lead to faster and more cost-effective code searches within AI-driven development environments.
items.why_it_matters: Reducing token usage in code searches can significantly lower costs and improve efficiency for developers using AI agents.
